description: Agent FinOps — create a spend cap over an org / project / agent for a period. With enforcement 'block', a run or mesh hop that would breach the cap is rejected server-side (HTTP 402). Requires a key with write scope.

alertThresholdPct.description: Percent of the cap that flips state to 'warn'. Default 80.

enforcement.description: 'block' rejects a breaching run/hop (HTTP 402); 'alert' only warns. Default block.

limitCredits.description: Spend cap in credits for the period.

scopeId.description: The project/agent id — required unless scopeType is 'org'.
